attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Nebraska state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 4 brackets per Nebraska Department of Revenue (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Nebraska Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.ne_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NE tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ne_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /ne_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ne_tax xdef
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_1_limit min result.ne_bracket_1_rate mul /ne_tax xdef
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_1_limit gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_2_limit min result.ne_bracket_1_limit sub result.ne_bracket_2_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_2_limit gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit min result.ne_bracket_2_limit sub result.ne_bracket_3_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit sub result.ne_bracket_4_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_tax result.ne_personal_exemption_credit sub 0 max /ne_tax xdef
ne_tax /result.ne_state_tax xdef ne_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Nebraska tax calculated (Single): $" result.ne_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NE tax for Married Filing Jointly using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.ne_standard_deduction_joint sub 0 max dup /ne_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /ne_tax xdef
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_1_limit_joint min result.ne_bracket_1_rate mul /ne_tax xdef
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_1_limit_joint gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_2_limit_joint min result.ne_bracket_1_limit_joint sub result.ne_bracket_2_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_2_limit_joint gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit_joint min result.ne_bracket_2_limit_joint sub result.ne_bracket_3_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit_joint gt { ne_taxable_income result.ne_bracket_3_limit_joint sub result.ne_bracket_4_rate mul ne_tax add /ne_tax xdef } if
ne_tax result.ne_personal_exemption_credit 2 mul sub 0 max /ne_tax xdef
ne_tax /result.ne_state_tax xdef ne_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Nebraska tax calculated (MFJ): $" result.ne_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Nebraska military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption since 2022 (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NE Military Retirement Exclusion Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Full exclusion - 100% of military retirement pay excluded from NE taxable income (since 2022)
action_details.action_postfix:
taxpayer.military_retirement_pay get /result.ne_military_retirement_exclusion xdef
result.ne_subtractions get result.ne_military_retirement_exclusion get add /result.ne_subtractions xdef
"NE Military Retirement Exclusion (Full since 2022): $" result.ne_military_retirement_exclusion get cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_postfix: 0 /result.ne_military_retirement_exclusion xdef "NE Military Retirement Exclusion: None (no military retirement pay)" job.audit_trail swap addto
